settings.concello_id.label: Municipality code (INE)
settings.concello_id.description: INE municipality code (e.g. 15035 for Fene, 15036 for Ferrol, 15030 for A Coruña, 15078 for Santiago, 36057 for Vigo).
settings.concello_name.label: Town display name
settings.concello_name.description: Custom name to show on the bar and panel (e.g. Fene).
settings.refresh_minutes.label: Update interval (minutes)
settings.refresh_minutes.description: How often to refresh forecast data from MeteoGalicia (default: 30 minutes).
settings.show_town_name.label: Show town name on bar
settings.show_town_name.description: Displays the municipality name next to the temperature.
settings.show_rain_prob.label: Show rain probability
settings.show_rain_prob.description: Displays precipitation chance on the bar when greater than 0%.
settings.hours_count.label: Hourly forecast entries
settings.hours_count.description: Number of upcoming hourly entries in the panel (up to 48 hours organized in 12h blocks).
settings.show_daily_summary.label: Show daily summary in panel
settings.show_daily_summary.description: Displays the smoothed daily trend chart (Today, Tomorrow...) beneath the hourly forecast.
settings.show_daily_hourly_curve.label: Show hourly curve in daily chart
settings.show_daily_hourly_curve.descrip: Draws the continuous hourly temperature curve inside the daily trend chart.
settings.ui_scale.label: Panel, font, and icon size
settings.ui_scale.description: Adjusts the overall scale of panel, text, and icons proportionally to improve readability.
settings.panel_opacity.label: Panel background opacity
settings.panel_opacity.description: Controls panel and card transparency to enhance contrast.
ui.hourly_track_hint: Hover over points to see time, temperature and rain
